description: This file implements the QWebChannel class and related functions for enabling communication between a web page and a Qt backend, part of the QtWebChannel module. It defines message types, object handling, signal and method invocation, and property management.

classes.name: QWebChannel
classes.description: Main class facilitating communication between JavaScript and Qt backend, managing message passing, object registration, and callback handling.

classes.name: QObject
classes.description: Represents a Qt object in JavaScript, managing signals, properties, and method calls, and handling object unwrapping and signal emission.

methods.name: QWebChannel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the web channel with transport and callback, setting up message handling and object creation.

methods.name: unwrapQObject
methods.description: Unwraps a response object into a QObject instance if applicable.

methods.name: unwrapProperties
methods.description: Unwraps all cached properties of the QObject.

methods.name: signalEmitted
methods.description: Invokes callbacks associated with a specific signal.

methods.name: propertyUpdate
methods.description: Updates property cache and triggers signal callbacks upon property change.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Sends a message to the Qt backend, optionally with a callback for response.
